text.p: Tropical Cyclone Melanie an increasing risk to shipping in the south Indian Ocean during the next 48 hours. Winds are currently up to 60 mph and they may reach 80 mph by the end of the 48 hour period. It will move westward between 9 and 10 south from 90 east to 80 east during this period. It could threaten Diego Garcia early next week, but this is uncertain.

A disturbance in the South China Sea continues to gain strength. Numerous thunderstorms are evident on satelite pictures. These are likely causing squalls and rough seas. A cylone is getting organized near 10n/117e. Winds in this area are 20-25 mph but further strengthening is likely. This system may become a depression or storm this weekend as it moves towards the west at 10 mph.
There are no further statements at this time.
